# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 37 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_037_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 7 — Fear God, Not the Devil

**1** "Fear the Lord," he said, "and keep his commandments. When you keep his commandments you'll be strong in everything you do, and what you do will be incomparable. Because when you truly fear him, everything you do comes out right." **2** "This is the kind of fear that saves you. But stop fearing the devil. **3** Fear the Lord and you'll have power over the devil — because the devil has no real power. And you don't need to fear what has no power. **4** The one who deserves to be feared is the one with genuine, glorious power. Whoever is truly powerful commands fear; whoever has no power commands no fear from anyone. **5** Be alert to the devil's deeds, yes — because they're evil. But fear the Lord's works, keep his commandments, and you'll live to God." **6** "Sir, these commandments have really strengthened me," I said. "I know I'll be saved if I keep them." "You will," he said. "You and everyone who keeps these commandments of the Lord."

---

*PNEUMA note: "Fear the Lord's works, not the devil's" reframes fear as directional — all your fear-energy should be invested in God, not the enemy. The devil is simply not worth the emotional and spiritual expenditure of fear.*
